title: rpl/dodag: NaN/inf link_etx crashes path_cost
description: In dodag.py, the link_etx validation (lines 84-86, 178-179) uses 'if link_etx < 0' which does not catch NaN or positive infinity. Both float('nan') < 0 and float('inf') < 0 return False, so these values pass validation. When path_cost() calls round(self.link_etx * min_hop_rank_increase) at line 94, NaN raises ValueError and inf raises OverflowError, crashing the DODAG state machine. Fix: add 'if math.isnan(link_etx) or math.isinf(link_etx): raise ValueError(...)' in both validation locations.
close_reason: Duplicate of dfv6: finite-ETX validation in ParentCandidate.__post_init__ and process_dio using math.isnan/math.isinf.
